tools.name: extract_folder_documents
tools.description: Extracts document contents, file metadata, and mission context from a Google Drive mission folder.

folderId.description: Google Drive folder URL or 33-character folder ID

tools.name: generate_one_pager_slide
tools.description: Generates a Google Slides executive summary card using the Artefact EOM master template.

folderId.description: Google Drive folder URL or ID to save the presentation in

cardData.description: Dictionary of synthesized debrief fields: Context, Objectives, Deliverables, Team, Key Results, Learnings

templateId.description: Template presentation ID to copy from

tools.name: create_audit_sheet
tools.description: Creates a Google Sheets audit checklist tracking confidentiality, risk level, and sanitization flags for mission deliverables.

folderId.description: Google Drive folder URL or ID to save the audit sheet in

auditRecords.description: List of file audit records with classification, risk_level, and recommendations

tools.name: send_lead_notification
tools.description: Sends an email notification via Gmail to the Mission Lead containing links to the generated Slide and Sheet.

recipientEmail.description: Email address of the Mission Lead

slideUrl.description: Link to the generated Google Slides deck

sheetUrl.description: Link to the generated Google Sheets audit checklist
